pages.text: Every frame in Bee Mastery carries four numbers: production (how fast the hive works), lifespan (how quickly the queen's genes decay), mutation (bonus mutation chance), and territory (how far the hive's effects, including auras, reach).

pages.title: Frame of Mutation
pages.text: A specialist: half the lifespan but ten times the mutation chance. Built for breeding through the tandem line fast, not for long-term production.
